verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm OneDrive has a free tier with a limited storage allotment: one user cites '20 gigabyte they give you for free', another says it is 'free until it isn't'. It is turned on by default on Windows, which suggests the same clients serve free users. The Graph docs describe a single API for OneDrive users but never mention free accounts. missing for 10: first-party published free-tier quota, official confirmation that free accounts get the same clients and Graph API access, consistent quota figure.
